display.title: Shiva Asar B'Tammuz: From Baseless Hatred to Ahavas Yisroel
display.summary_short: What happened on the seventeenth of Tammuz, why the fast was postponed that year, and how love between Jews will rebuild the Beis HaMikdash.
display.summary_long: A short teaching from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, recorded the week of Shiva Asar B'Tammuz. Uncle Yossi explains that on the seventeenth of Tammuz the enemy broke into Yerushalayim, which led to the destruction of the Beis HaMikdash on Tisha B'Av at the end of the Three Weeks. It is a fast day with Selichos, when we remember past mistakes and try not to repeat them. Since that year it fell on Shabbos, the fast was postponed to Sunday, and the Chachamim say that just as it was postponed one day, may it be postponed forever and become a day of joy. The Beis HaMikdash was destroyed because of sinas chinam, hating for no reason, so it will be rebuilt through Ahavas Yisroel. The clip ends by introducing the story of two brothers whose love led Hashem to choose Har HaMoriah; the story itself is not included.
display.lesson: The Beis HaMikdash was destroyed through baseless hatred and will be rebuilt through love for every Jew.
